title: Portable Agent Memory Capability Token
description: A capability token that grants scoped, time-bounded permissions over Portable Agent Memory entries. Tokens are cryptographically signed by their issuer.

id.description: Unique identifier for this capability token.

scope.description: Defines which entries this token grants access to.

type.description: Scoping strategy: 'entry_ids' targets specific entries, 'component' targets an entire memory component, 'tag' targets entries matching tags, 'wildcard' targets all entries.

oneOf.description: List of entry IDs, component names, or tag values depending on scope type.

value.description: The scope value — an array of identifiers or '*' for wildcard.

permissions.description: Set of permissions granted by this token.

issuer.description: Identifier of the entity that issued this token.

issuer_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the token content (base64-encoded), produced by the issuer's private key.

audience.description: Identifier of the target agent this token is issued to, or null if bearer-scoped.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this token was issued.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this token expires.

binding_params.description: Optional additional constraints on the token (e.g. IP restrictions, rate limits).
